posts.text: Diageo's annual dividend rate dropped 39.8% to $2.00, a cut first seen on Oct 17. The company's 5-year dividend growth rate stands at 2.6%. 📉
Dick's Sporting Goods shows a 31.1% 5-year dividend growth rate. The retailer maintains an 11-year streak of annual increases. 📈
Microsoft's annual dividend rose 7.7% to $3.92, a change first seen on Oct 16. The company has increased its payout for 15 consecutive years.
Nike's current yield of 4.37% is 3.1 times its 5-year average yield of 1.41%. The brand holds a 23-year streak of dividend increases.
ASA Gold raised its annual rate 25% to $0.10, first seen on Oct 20. The 5-year dividend growth rate for the firm is 24.6%. 📈
Zoetis goes ex-dividend on Oct 30. The company pays quarterly and has a 12-year streak of annual dividend increases. 📅
Intertek's annual dividend rate fell 34.5% to £1.08, a change first seen on Oct 28. The 5-year dividend growth rate is 8.6%. 📉
